related.title: 單陀螺降級模式與漂移管理
related.titleEn: Single-gyro degraded mode and drift management
related.transfer: 沿感測器、估測器、致動器與受控衛星對照邊界。
related.transferEn: Compare boundaries across sensors, estimator, actuators, and controlled spacecraft.
related.why: 兩課都要求可複查的姿態殘差及模式轉移紀錄；請先找到證據格式的共通欄位。
related.whyEn: Both courses require a reviewable attitude-residual and mode-transition log. First find the evidence fields they share.
related.difference: 完成「單陀螺降級模式與漂移管理」工作台並留下可重做的工程紀錄。
related.differenceEn: Complete the single-gyro degraded mode and drift management bench and produce a reproducible engineering record.
practice: 各選一個名義結果，保留輸入與來源。
對照介面、失效條件與資料解析度。
把一項驗證改編到另一案例，記下不可沿用的假設。
practiceEn: Select one nominal result in each case, retaining inputs and sources.
Compare interfaces, failure conditions, and data resolution.
Transfer a verification to the other case and document assumptions that do not carry across.
